description: Use this when the user is naming a product or company and asks whether the name is free beyond the domain: a GitHub account or org, an npm package, or a US trademark ("is acme taken on GitHub", "is there a trademark for acme"). Checks GitHub, the npm registry and live USPTO marks right now; each answer carries its source URL and checked time. "none" means the source has no record, never that the name is available or safe to use; a trademark search is not legal clearance. For the domain itself, call check_domain_availability.

name.description: A bare name like "acme" (a domain like "acme.io" is cut to "acme"). Max 63 characters after cleanup.
